project_meta.title: What To Do When an Aggressive Stranger Confronts You on the Road

global_style.art_style: Premium polished 2D editorial cartoon animation, featuring consistent full-body human cartoon characters with structured anatomy rather than thin line stick figures. Every character has a large rounded white head, a clearly defined solid torso, two proportionate arms, two proportionate legs, visible hands and shoes. Characters must maintain identical body proportions, head size, limb thickness, clothing and facial design across every image. Main character: young adult male with a rounded white head, exactly two tiny solid-black circular dot eyes, no nose, no mouth, short dark hair, cobalt-blue hoodie, charcoal trousers and white sneakers. Other human characters follow the same structured cartoon anatomy and identical simple facial system. Faces must never become realistic or detailed. Bold clean dark outlines, smooth solid color fills, subtle paper texture, cinematic lighting, rich but controlled colors, expressive body language through posture and gestures, professional visual storytelling, carefully composed vertical 9:16 frames. Characters must always be fully formed cartoon people, never single-line figures, wireframe bodies, floating heads, incomplete limbs or inconsistent stick figures. Keep the visual style consistent across every scene.
global_style.negative_prompt: Thin single-line stick figures, wireframe people, inconsistent body proportions, changing character designs, missing limbs, floating hands, detached body parts, oversized or tiny heads, realistic human faces, detailed eyes, pupils, irises, eye highlights, eyelashes, extra eyes, different eye spacing, facial expressions drawn with detailed features, 3D rendering, photorealism, anime, messy sketches, washed-out colors, overly pale images, cluttered backgrounds, text, captions, logos, watermarks, gore, physical violence, weapons.

main_character.label: Arjun - Main Character
main_character.visual_dna: A young adult male cartoon character with a large rounded white head, exactly two tiny solid-black circular dot eyes with identical spacing, no nose and no mouth. Short neat dark hair. Fixed outfit: cobalt-blue hoodie, charcoal-black straight trousers and clean white sneakers. Clearly structured full-body anatomy with a solid torso, proportionate arms and legs, visible hands and shoes. Consistent head-to-body ratio, clothing and limb thickness in every appearance.

aggressive_driver.label: Aggressive SUV Driver
aggressive_driver.visual_dna: A tall, broad-shouldered adult male cartoon character with a rounded white head, exactly two tiny solid-black circular dot eyes, no nose and no mouth. Short dark hair, dark maroon jacket, black trousers and dark brown shoes. Structured full-body cartoon anatomy with solid torso and proportionate limbs. Intimidating posture but no physical violence.

friend.label: Arjun's Friend
friend.visual_dna: A young adult male cartoon character with a rounded white head, exactly two tiny solid-black circular dot eyes, no nose and no mouth. Short black hair, olive-green sweatshirt, dark blue jeans and grey sneakers. Structured full-body cartoon anatomy, consistent proportions and clothing.

city_road.label: Urban Road
city_road.visual_dna: A realistic but stylized Indian urban road with clearly marked lanes, moving cars, motorcycles, roadside shops, streetlights and a few pedestrians. Warm late-afternoon lighting, clean cinematic 2D cartoon background.

car_interior.label: Inside Arjun's Car
car_interior.visual_dna: Interior of a modest modern compact car, dark dashboard, steering wheel, front seats, side windows and rear-view mirror. Clean detailed 2D cartoon design with natural daylight.

public_fuel_station.label: Busy Fuel Station
public_fuel_station.visual_dna: A well-lit, busy urban fuel station with pumps, a small convenience shop, several parked vehicles and visible customers. Safe public environment with staff and CCTV cameras.

beats.narration_text: सोचो, तुम अपनी कार से घर जा रहे हो और अचानक एक बड़ी एसयूवी तुम्हारा रास्ता काट देती है।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 cinematic view of an Indian urban road in late afternoon. A compact blue car driven by Arjun, a fully formed cartoon man with a white rounded head, exactly two tiny black dot eyes, cobalt-blue hoodie, charcoal trousers and white sneakers, approaches an intersection. A large black SUV suddenly cuts across his lane. Show both complete vehicles, road markings, nearby traffic and roadside shops. Premium polished 2D cartoon style, bold clean outlines, rich colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish Arjun's exact clothing and structured full-body cartoon proportions. Keep his two tiny black dot eyes identical.

beats.narration_text: तुम ब्रेक लगाते हो। लेकिन वो आदमी बाहर निकलकर उल्टा तुम्हें ही धमकाने लगता है।
beats.prompt_action: A broad-shouldered adult male cartoon character wearing a maroon jacket, black trousers and brown shoes has stepped out of a large black SUV and stands beside its open door, aggressively pointing toward Arjun's compact blue car. Arjun remains visible inside his car. Both characters have rounded white heads and exactly two tiny black dot eyes. The SUV driver has a large intimidating stance. Urban traffic continues behind them. Premium polished 2D cartoon animation, dramatic late-afternoon light, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the SUV driver broad-shouldered and in the same maroon jacket. Arjun remains in his blue hoodie.

beats.narration_text: अब तुम्हारे पास दो रास्ते हैं। पहला, गुस्से में बाहर निकलकर उससे भिड़ जाना।
beats.prompt_action: Inside a compact blue car, Arjun in his cobalt-blue hoodie grips the steering wheel tightly with both hands. His shoulders are tense and his body leans forward as he looks toward the angry SUV driver outside. His full head, upper body, both arms and steering wheel are clearly visible. Rounded white face with exactly two tiny black dot eyes, no other facial details. Premium polished 2D cartoon, expressive body language, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Arjun's hoodie, head shape, eye design and body proportions remain unchanged.

beats.narration_text: तुम चिल्लाते हो, बहस करते हो और साबित करने लगते हो कि तुम किसी से डरते नहीं।
beats.prompt_action: Arjun, wearing his cobalt-blue hoodie, charcoal trousers and white sneakers, stands beside his blue car and angrily gestures with both hands toward the broad-shouldered SUV driver in a maroon jacket. The SUV driver points back aggressively. Both are complete structured cartoon people with visible torsos, arms, legs and shoes, rounded white heads and exactly two tiny black dot eyes. Several passing vehicles slow down behind them. Premium polished 2D cartoon with dramatic composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the confrontation as escalating through posture and gestures only. No physical contact.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन अब एक छोटी सी सड़क की गलती खतरनाक टकराव बन सकती है।
beats.prompt_action: High-angle cinematic view of a busy Indian road. Arjun in his blue hoodie stands near his compact blue car facing the much larger maroon-jacketed SUV driver. Their vehicles obstruct part of the lane as other cars queue behind them. Pedestrians watch from a distance. Show the growing traffic disruption and tense atmosphere. All people have consistent rounded white heads, exactly two tiny black dot eyes and complete structured cartoon bodies. Premium polished 2D cartoon style.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Maintain the same two character designs and vehicles.

beats.narration_text: दूसरा रास्ता है अपनी सुरक्षा को अपनी इज़्ज़त से भी ऊपर रखना।
beats.prompt_action: Inside his compact blue car, Arjun pauses, takes a controlled breath and relaxes his hands slightly on the steering wheel. His cobalt-blue hoodie and rounded white head with exactly two tiny black dot eyes are clearly visible. The aggressive man appears blurred outside the side window. Warm sunlight falls across the dashboard. Premium polished 2D cartoon, cinematic depth, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Arjun transitions from anger to deliberate calm without changing his character design.

beats.narration_text: सबसे पहले, गाड़ी के अंदर रहो अगर वहाँ रहना सुरक्षित है। दरवाज़े लॉक रखो।
beats.prompt_action: Arjun sits securely inside his compact blue car, wearing the same cobalt-blue hoodie. One hand is near the door lock and the other rests on the steering wheel. Show the closed car doors, windows and locked-door indicator clearly. The maroon-jacketed aggressive driver is visible outside at a safe distance. Arjun has a rounded white head with exactly two tiny black dot eyes and consistent structured cartoon anatomy. Premium polished 2D cartoon style.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The car doors remain closed. Arjun stays inside the vehicle.

beats.narration_text: खिड़की से बहस मत करो। धमकी का जवाब धमकी से मत दो।
beats.prompt_action: View from outside the closed side window of Arjun's compact blue car. Inside, Arjun in his cobalt-blue hoodie calmly keeps his hands visible and avoids arguing. Outside, the maroon-jacketed driver gestures angrily but does not touch the car. Show a clear glass barrier between them. Both characters retain rounded white heads and exactly two tiny black dot eyes. Premium polished 2D cartoon, cinematic reflections, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: No threatening gestures from Arjun. Maintain physical distance.

beats.narration_text: अगर रास्ता खुला है, तो सुरक्षित तरीके से वहाँ से निकलो।
beats.prompt_action: A compact blue car driven by Arjun carefully moves away from the confrontation along an open lane. The black SUV and its maroon-jacketed driver remain behind at a distance. Show normal traffic, clear road markings and a safe gap between vehicles. Arjun is visible through the windshield wearing his cobalt-blue hoodie. Premium polished 2D cartoon, smooth cinematic movement, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The blue car moves away calmly, without speeding or dangerous maneuvers.

beats.narration_text: और अगर कोई पीछा कर रहा है, तो सीधे घर मत जाओ।
beats.prompt_action: Close cinematic view of the rear-view mirror inside Arjun's blue car. In the mirror, a black SUV driven by the maroon-jacketed aggressive man follows at a distance. Arjun's cobalt-blue sleeve and one hand on the steering wheel are visible in the foreground. The mirror, dashboard and road outside are clearly drawn. Premium polished 2D cartoon, suspenseful lighting, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The SUV is following from a distance. Do not depict a collision or dangerous chase.

beats.narration_text: किसी भीड़भाड़ वाली जगह, पेट्रोल पंप या पुलिस सहायता केंद्र की तरफ जाओ।
beats.prompt_action: Arjun's compact blue car enters a busy, brightly lit fuel station with multiple customers, staff members, fuel pumps and CCTV cameras. The black SUV remains farther back on the public road. Arjun is visible through his windshield wearing the same cobalt-blue hoodie. The environment feels populated and safe. Premium polished 2D cartoon, rich colors and cinematic vertical composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The fuel station is a public, populated place. Keep the SUV at a distance.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि तुम्हारा लक्ष्य उसे हराना नहीं, सुरक्षित जगह पहुँचना है।
beats.prompt_action: Arjun stands beside his parked blue car inside the busy fuel station, speaking to a uniformed fuel station employee. Arjun wears his cobalt-blue hoodie, charcoal trousers and white sneakers. His complete structured cartoon body is visible, with rounded white head and exactly two tiny black dot eyes. Several customers and CCTV cameras are visible in the background. Premium polished 2D cartoon, reassuring atmosphere.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Arjun remains calm and seeks help from people in the public place.

beats.narration_text: अब किसी भरोसेमंद इंसान को कॉल करो और अपनी लोकेशन बताओ।
beats.prompt_action: At the busy fuel station, Arjun in his cobalt-blue hoodie holds a smartphone to his ear and speaks calmly. His rounded white head, exactly two tiny black dot eyes and upper body are clearly visible. His blue car is parked behind him. Other customers and fuel station staff are present. Premium polished 2D cartoon, warm lighting, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Arjun is contacting a trusted person, not arguing with the aggressor.

beats.narration_text: अगर धमकी दी गई है, तो सुरक्षित दूरी से घटना की जानकारी और सबूत संभालकर रखो।
beats.prompt_action: Over-the-shoulder view of Arjun holding his smartphone at the fuel station. The phone screen shows a generic camera recording interface without readable text. In the distant background, the black SUV is visible near the road. Arjun's cobalt-blue sleeve and rounded white head with exactly two tiny black dot eyes are partially visible. Premium polished 2D cartoon, crisp smartphone details, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Documentation is done only from a safe distance. Do not show Arjun approaching the SUV.

beats.narration_text: अगर खतरा बना हुआ है, तो पुलिस या आपातकालीन सहायता से संपर्क करो।
beats.prompt_action: Arjun stands beside a fuel station employee and calmly makes a phone call for official assistance. He wears his cobalt-blue hoodie, charcoal trousers and white sneakers. His complete structured cartoon body and exact two-dot-eye face design are visible. A public CCTV camera and several customers appear in the background. Premium polished 2D cartoon, confident and safe atmosphere.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The character seeks official assistance. No physical confrontation.

beats.narration_text: याद रखो, किसी अनजान आदमी का अहंकार बचाना तुम्हारी ज़िम्मेदारी नहीं है।
beats.prompt_action: Arjun stands safely near the entrance of the busy fuel station, his compact blue car parked nearby. In the far background, the maroon-jacketed SUV driver stands beside his black vehicle, now visually separated from Arjun by distance and other people. Arjun's posture is relaxed and composed. Both characters have identical simple two-dot-eye facial design and complete structured cartoon bodies. Premium polished 2D cartoon, cinematic warm lighting.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Emphasize distance, calmness and safety rather than victory or humiliation.

beats.narration_text: अगली सुबह अरुण अपने दोस्त को पूरी घटना बताता है।
beats.prompt_action: The next morning, Arjun wearing his cobalt-blue hoodie, charcoal trousers and white sneakers sits at a small outdoor cafe table with his friend wearing an olive-green sweatshirt, dark blue jeans and grey sneakers. Both are complete structured cartoon characters with rounded white heads and exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes. Arjun explains the previous day's incident using calm hand gestures. Warm morning light, premium polished 2D cartoon, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Maintain exact character designs and outfits for both men.

beats.narration_text: उसका दोस्त पूछता है, लेकिन अगर लोग तुम्हें डरपोक समझें तो?
beats.prompt_action: Arjun's friend in an olive-green sweatshirt leans forward across the cafe table, raising one hand as if asking a serious question. Arjun in his cobalt-blue hoodie listens quietly. Both have rounded white heads, exactly two tiny black dot eyes and consistent complete cartoon anatomy. Cafe background softly blurred. Premium polished 2D cartoon, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Friend's outfit and facial design remain identical.

beats.narration_text: अरुण मुस्कुराकर कहता है, डरपोक वो नहीं जो लड़ाई से बचता है।
beats.prompt_action: Close cinematic view of Arjun in his cobalt-blue hoodie sitting at the cafe table. He raises one hand slightly while explaining his point with a composed posture. His rounded white head has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no nose and no mouth. His friend is softly visible across the table. Premium polished 2D cartoon, warm sunlight and clean outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Arjun remains composed and confident, without changing his face or clothing.

beats.narration_text: समझदार वो है जो जानता है कि कब जवाब देना है और कब वहाँ से निकल जाना है।
beats.prompt_action: Arjun walks confidently along a clean city sidewalk in morning sunlight, wearing his cobalt-blue hoodie, charcoal trousers and white sneakers. His entire body is visible with a solid torso, proportionate arms and legs, clearly drawn hands and shoes. His rounded white head has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes. Modern city buildings and pedestrians form a pleasant background. Premium polished 2D cartoon, cinematic composition, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show confidence through upright posture, not aggression. Preserve exact character proportions.

beats.narration_text: अगली बार कोई तुम्हें बेवजह उकसाए, तो याद रखना, तुम्हें हर बहस जीतने की ज़रूरत नहीं।
beats.prompt_action: Arjun walks away from a tense roadside situation toward a bright, populated public area. He wears his cobalt-blue hoodie, charcoal trousers and white sneakers. His full structured cartoon body is visible. In the distant background, two other drivers calmly stand near their parked vehicles while traffic continues normally. Rounded white heads with exactly two tiny black dot eyes on all people. Premium polished 2D cartoon, uplifting cinematic sunlight, uncluttered vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Final image communicates smart self-control and personal safety.

beats.narration_text: तुम्हारे हिसाब से ऐसी स्थिति में सबसे समझदारी वाला कदम क्या होगा?
beats.prompt_action: Arjun stands facing the camera on a clean urban sidewalk, wearing his cobalt-blue hoodie, charcoal trousers and white sneakers. Show his complete structured cartoon body from head to shoes, with consistent proportions, rounded white head and exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes. He raises one open hand in a friendly question gesture. Bright uncluttered city background, premium polished 2D cartoon, strong clean outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep Arjun's exact established character design. End with a welcoming, thoughtful pose.
